expected.finding: **[P1]** **PR-controlled tests can tamper with review artifacts.** In `.github/workflows/codex-review.yml`, switching to `workspace-write` makes `/tmp` writable by default ([Codex source](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/protocol/src/protocol.rs)). The workflow stores `/tmp/codex-review-raw.txt` and `/tmp/codex-review-err.txt` there. A malicious test or `conftest.py` can modify those files directly, compromising the evidence subsequently processed as reviewer output without requiring prompt injection. Keep review artifacts and trusted executable helpers outside sandbox-writable directories, and give tests a separate scratch directory.

**[P2]** **Missing trace timestamps become evidence in every historical epoch.** In `scripts/measure-policy-validity.py`, `anchor_counts_at()` uses `(t.get("timestamp") or 0) <= until_ms`. The collector permits missing timestamps, so an undated trace is treated as existing since the Unix epoch. This can make historical validity appear supported by evidence whose availability at that time is unknown. For historical measurements, mark affected counts unknown instead of assigning missing timestamps zero.
